messages:
Priya: FYI the US-west GPU invoice came in ~22% over forecast; there's an ~$18k unallocated chunk tied to project=ephemeral-runner-01 :eyes:
Anya: That's the new CI autoscale pool we flipped last week, right?
Ben: Yep. Autoscaler bug prevented proper scale-down on spot nodes; nodes stuck and kept billing. I opened infra ticket and am investigating logs.
Luis: Reproduced. A recent config change mistakenly set `min_nodes: 2` for the spot pool in us-west. The controller kept nodes alive even when pods drained. Check `kubectl get hpa -n infra-autoscale`.
Priya: Can we retro-tag those VMs so finance can reassign charges? Reports show `unlabeled` and it's breaking internal chargebacks.
Ben: I'll run a backfill that maps instance IDs to PR/owner metadata and add labels in the billing export. BigQuery snippet I'm using:
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, project.id, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export.ga_billing_*`
WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND labels.autoscale_pool='ephemeral-runner-01'
GROUP BY resource.labels.instance_id, project.id;
```
I'll push results to a shared sheet.
Anya: If we can get that before EOD we can adjust team budgets before monthly close. Finance, what's the retro reclassification playbook?
finance-bot: Reminder: cost reclassification window = 30 days. Submit ticket in #finance with CSV (instance_id, owner_team, amount, invoice_id). Automated job will apply adjustments to next allocation run.
Priya: Filing ticket now; will attach Ben's sheet. Also, should we ask vendor for a one-time credit for these orphan charges?
CFO-Bot: Vendor credits/prepay affects liquidity. Recommend reclassification unless recurring exposure > $25k and pattern repeats; escalate to finance leadership in that case.
Luis: Mitigation: reverted the `min_nodes` override and added a guard in the autoscale controller (rev 3a7f). Will monitor two cycles.
Ben: Backfill started  ETA ~3h. Will post CSV + sheet link when done. :thumbsup:
Anya: After reclassification, run internal alert report to find teams near alert thresholds so budgets can be topped up if needed.
Priya: Action items: Ben -> CSV & sheet, Priya -> finance ticket & attach CSV, Luis -> confirm fix & monitor, Anya -> update alert/budget runs.
Ben: Sheet posted: https://redwood-internal/sheets/ci-orphan-backfill (read-only).
finance-bot: Ticket FIN-2026-483 created. Attach CSV + invoice id to proceed with reclassification.
Priya: Will close loop once ticket processed. Post here for any updates. :white_check_mark:
